howDrawn.title: What is data and what is model
howDrawn.positions: Each car's position (x, y and height), about 4 times per second.
howDrawn.timing: Lap times, tyres, telemetry and race control messages, from timing.
howDrawn.sessionEstimated: In this session, not all of the above comes from the source as is
howDrawn.interpolation: Between one position and the next, the movement is interpolated. If more than {s} s pass without a position, the car is not drawn in that gap.
howDrawn.centreLine: The source does not say where across the track each car is: it is drawn on the centre line, by distance travelled, with its nose pointing along the track. If the source puts it less than 30 m from the centre line (e.g. in the gravel), it is drawn on the track; further away, the car is hidden.
howDrawn.pit: In the pits (between the entry and exit times given by the timing, and near them when the position is closer to the pit lane than to the track), the car is drawn on the pit-lane line; in the garage, it is hidden.
howDrawn.forward: A car is never drawn going backwards: if the source places it moving back (noise or a spin), the distance travelled is adjusted so that it does not decrease; if that adjustment would move it more than 5 m, or the telemetry says it was moving while the position stayed frozen, that stretch has no data and the car is not drawn.
howDrawn.width: The track has a generic {m} m width, not each circuit's own. From afar, the track and the cars have a minimum on-screen size so they stay visible.
howDrawn.car: The 3D car is generic: it carries the team colour and, on the tyres, the colour of the compound given by timing (grey with no data).
howDrawn.trails: Trails are the last {s} s of the same movement drawn for the car: they also run on the centre line and break where the car is not drawn. Coloured by speed, each point carries the last speed measured at most {age} s earlier, not interpolated; with none, grey.
howDrawn.drs: DRS zones are deduced from where cars had DRS open according to their telemetry: they are not the official lines, which no source provides, and they carry the “Estimated” label. In 2026 there is no DRS and no per-car channel, so none are drawn.
howDrawn.sectors: Sector colours are calculated by Trazada from the official sector times: they are not the timing feed’s marks, which the source does not include.
howDrawn.compare: When comparing two drivers, the live gap comes from the distance given by the GPS: it is shown in tenths and carries the “Estimated” label; the exact one is the official gap, when the lap ends. The ghost is the other car on its reference lap, drawn as in the replay and shifted in time; where there is no position, it is not drawn.
howDrawn.weather: Weather comes from the circuit’s station, one reading per minute: the latest is shown, not interpolated, and after {s} s without another it becomes «no data». Nothing the source lacks is ever filled with 0.
howDrawn.sky: The sky and the fog in the scene are decorative: they come from the session time and the circuit’s location, not from the weather at the time.
howDrawn.estimated: Anything calculated or exaggerated (height ×2 or ×3, spreading cars, lap 1…) carries the “Estimated” label.

sessionNotes.title: Processing notes for this session

note.dev-source: Development data (secondary source TracingInsights): for local use only, never published.
note.merged-telemetry: Positions and telemetry have been reconstructed from the merged telemetry of each lap.
note.track-status-from-race-control: Track status is inferred from race control messages and there is no timing tower.
note.dev-corners: The circuit's corners and rotation come from a development copy (TracingInsights).
note.dev-circuit: Circuit {circuit} uses development sources, so the session is marked as development data.
note.position-coverage-low: {cars} drivers have less than 99% position coverage (the lowest, {minPos}%): where it is missing, the car is not drawn.
note.centerline-not-closed: The circuit's centre line does not quite close: there are {closureM} m between its end and its start.
note.length-vs-official: The layout length ({lengthM} m) differs by more than 3% from the official one ({officialM} m).
note.no-corners: The circuit was built without the official corners and rotation (they were not reachable): the map has no corner numbers and may look rotated.
note.finish-line-fallback: The finish line is approximate: only {laps} laps could be used to place it.
note.lights-out-unknown: The exact start time is unknown: playback starts at the beginning of the data and lap 1 is not estimated.
note.e2e-extract: Trimmed extract of the session, for tests only.
note.e2e-variant: Made-up test variant: not a real session.
note.circuit-fit-unchecked: Could not check that this session fits circuit {circuit} (only {laps} clean laps): it is used unchecked.
note.circuit-variant-used: This session does not fit circuit {base}: its variant {circuit} is used.
note.circuit-layout-changed: The layout of this session does not fit the stored circuit {base}: variant {circuit} was built (did the layout change?).

circuit-rebuilt.outdated: Circuit {circuit} was rebuilt from this session (it was made with an older version).
circuit-rebuilt.gains-corners: Circuit {circuit} was rebuilt from this session, which has the official corners and rotation.
circuit-rebuilt.gains-pit: Circuit {circuit} had no pit lane: the one from this session has been added (nothing else changes).
circuit-rebuilt.other: Circuit {circuit} was rebuilt from this session.

circuit-outdated-kept.no-corners: Circuit {circuit} is from an older version, but this session has no official corners or rotation: it is used as is.
circuit-outdated-kept.build-failed: Circuit {circuit} is from an older version and could not be rebuilt from this session: it is used as is.
circuit-outdated-kept.would-lose: Circuit {circuit} is from an older version, but rebuilding it from this session would drop the pit lane or the sectors: it is used as is.
circuit-outdated-kept.other: Circuit {circuit} is from an older version and is used as is.

note.position-glitches: More than 1% of the positions of some cars ({cars}) are «no data» because of feed glitches (going backwards or frozen while moving).

pitlane-missing.no-stops: The circuit has no pit lane: the session it was built from had no pit stops. Cars in the pit lane are not drawn; it will be added when you download a session with pit stops.
pitlane-missing.none-valid: The circuit has no pit lane: none of the {stops} pit stops of the session it was built from gave one without gaps that the cars follow. Cars in the pit lane are not drawn; it will be added when you download a session with pit stops that gives one.
pitlane-missing.dropped: The circuit has no pit lane: the one it had did not follow the cars ({stopShare}% of the pit stops followed it) and no pit stop gave a good one. Cars in the pit lane are not drawn; it will be added when you download a session with pit stops that gives one.
pitlane-missing.other: The circuit has no pit lane: cars in the pit lane are not drawn.

estimated.hintUnknown: This value does not come from the source as is: it has been derived.

hints.elevation: Track height is multiplied so the elevation change is visible: it is not the real one.
hints.separation: Cars running together are spread across the track so you can tell them apart. The source does not say where across the track each car is: without spreading, it is drawn on the centre line.
hints.lap1: Live timing does not give the lap 1 time in a race. It is computed as the line crossing minus the start time, so it includes the run from the grid.
hints.positions: The source has no sampled positions for this session: they have been reconstructed from other data.
hints.telemetry: Telemetry for this session has been reconstructed from other data, it does not come from the source as is.
hints.trackStatus: No official track status: flags and neutralisations are inferred from race control messages.
hints.lapDelta: Computed from the GPS positions of both cars at the same distance covered, not from official timing. GPS is off by a few metres, so only tenths are given. The exact figure is the official timing one when the lap ends.
hints.minisectors: Trazada splits the track into minisectors and works out who is faster in each one from GPS positions: they are not the official minisectors. When the difference is very small, no winner is picked.
hints.drsZones: Inferred from where cars open DRS according to their telemetry: they are not the official detection and activation zones.
hints.overtakeTime: The overtake is confirmed by the official order at the finish line; the moment it happened is placed with both cars’ GPS positions within that lap (where their distances travelled cross), to within about a second. If the GPS does not show it, «exact moment: no data».
